source_integrity_findings.topic: plateau iris syndrome terminology / Case 1 sequence
source_integrity_findings.source_definition: The article defines plateau iris syndrome as recurrent/persistent gonioscopically confirmed angle closure after a patent iridotomy.
source_integrity_findings.case_1_sequence: Case 1 is labeled plateau iris syndrome before the report states that peripheral laser iridotomy and ALPI were then performed; no earlier iridotomy is documented in the case narrative.
source_integrity_findings.handling: Preserved without rewriting the case history; artifacts distinguish the source definition from the reported Case 1 sequence.
